summary: Read a list of integers. Move every zero to the end of the list while keeping the prior relative order of every nonzero integer. Perform the change inside the original list and do not copy the whole list aside. Write the list after the change. The order among zeros has no extra requirement. A correct result keeps nonzero integers in their prior relative order and places every zero at the end.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
